main_text.l: ἐπρσε[?] Σωόδων[?]. Particularium Synodorum una
Constantinopoli celebrata fuit in templo sancto-
rum Apostolorum sub Photio Patriarcha, quæ
Prima & Secunda dicitur: alia sub Leone, &
Constantino in celeberrimo sanctæ Dei Sapientiæ
templo, quæ Septimam Synodum confirmauit.
Septimæ Synodi confirmatio tantum in hac
de qua agimus Synodo Photiana visitur.
Septem præterea agnoscunt Schismatici alij
fere omnes, Psellus de Synodis, Matthæus
Blastarius in Nomocanone, Iosephus Bry-
ennius Orat. 8. de Trinitate, Matthæus Cy-
gala Cyprius in Historica Synopsi, & alij,
qui Photianam hanc penitus ignorant. tan-
demque Ioannes Imperator Constantino-
politanus in Synodo Florentina, vt refert
Syluester Syropulus in Historia eiusdem
Concilij sect. 9. cap. 4. Ἐγὼ τὸ παρὰς
Συνόδων[?], Florentinam nempe, οἰκουμενικὴν κατ᾽ ἰδίαν τόπον ἡγοῦμαι ἐλάττω[?] τῶν ἀφλαβεσῶν
ἱστὰ Συνόδων[?]. Διὰ τοῦτο θέλω, ὡς ταύτῃ ἀκολουθεῖν ἐκάνας καὶ πάντας[?]. &c. Ego quidem arbitror
hanc Synodum generalem nullatenus infra di-
gnitatem aliarum septem Generalium subsidere,
quæ eandem antevertunt. Quare volo, ut hac
illis par in omnibus succedat, nec aliud quid-
quam ab illis diversum in hac gestum pro-
deat. Nicephorus Gregoras Histor. lib. 19.
de Hæresi Palamæ. Εἶναι δὲ παλαιὰ τινὲς[?] νῦν φη-

page.notes: Several Greek words are uncertain and marked [?]: the opening word of the first line, the Greek quotation from Syropulus (its middle portion in particular) and the final Greek phrase. The long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "agnoscunt", "Schismatici", "Synopsi"), and u/v and i/j are normalised. The printed "fc" in "agnofcunt" is read as "sc". The last line of the page carries the catchword "φη-", which is set apart at the right below the text and is therefore not repeated in the paragraph.
